results.corrected_title: Amazon: AWS grows 39% but trailing free cash flow turns deeply negative and shares fall over 6% after hours
results.corrected_summary: Amazon reported Q3 results on 29 October 2026. AWS revenue rose 39% to $45.98B, above the $45.29B consensus. Quarterly capex was $77.3B, and Amazon kept its 2026 capex forecast at $220B. Trailing-twelve-month free cash flow was negative $42.4B, and shares fell more than 6% in extended trading.
key_facts: AWS revenue was $45.98B, up 39% year over year, against a $45.29B consensus (StreetAccount).
Quarterly capex was $77.3B, versus $35.1B a year earlier and a FactSet estimate of $58.7B.
The 2026 capex forecast was kept at $220B.
Trailing-twelve-month free cash flow was negative $42.4B.
Shares fell more than 6% in extended trading.
results.issues: Capex forecast maintained, not raised; negative FCF is trailing twelve months.

results.corrected_title: Anthropic: unreleased research model built working exploit chains in Chrome, Safari, Android, Windows and Linux
results.corrected_summary: On 27 October 2026 Anthropic published research describing an unreleased internal model that found serious vulnerabilities in widely used software. It built working exploit chains in five cases, four with remote code execution or similarly serious impact and one remote denial of service. All were reported to vendors under coordinated disclosure, and several are already patched.
key_facts: The model is described only as 'unreleased, internal'; no model name is given.
Chrome on macOS: a one-click chain, with 62 CVEs patched as of Chrome 156.
Safari: a one-click same-origin-policy bypass, fixed by Apple.
Android: a lock-screen bypass on a Pixel 9, addressed by Google.
Windows: a remote denial of service in the kernel's QUIC/HTTP3 code (CVE-2026-33096), fixed by Microsoft.
Linux: a zero-click remote root code execution flaw in the kernel's multipath TCP code (CVE-2026-98432), patched upstream.
Anthropic's disclosure policy gives vendors 90 days to patch.
results.issues: Primary source only; Anthropic's own account. Windows bug is denial of service.
